## Dieses Dokument

- Titel: Brief von Stefan Zweig an Hannah; Altmann, Manfred Altmann [Januar 1941], SZ-AAL/B1.87
- Signatur: SZ-AAL/B1.87
- Datum: 01.1941
- Objekttyp: Brief
- Umfang: 3 Scans

pages.transcription:
AEROGRAMMA
VIA PANAIR

Dear Hannah and Manfred, we have yesterday
arrived and I suppose you are hungry for news
about your daughter; I hope Lotte will feed you
substantially as she was yesterday at La Rochelle
and we have Era today here in New York. She is looking
all right, somewhat grown up and a bit shy; you
will pardon me that I was a little severe with her
when she had to confess not to have written a
single line to her grandmother through half a year
(and what a year!!) I think one must fortify in
her the sentiment for responsability at this early
hour and especially as she is now under indiffe-
rent care. Physically she seems to have had
the best choice but I doubt if in the long run
the milicu[?] would be useful.
I had a letter from Edemann today. If
he finds something particulary good for me
there will be soon opportunity for I shall
have some cash {on my account at the Westminster Bank}
from the investments
have has to deliver and so I can dispose
of more money in England. Here we arrived
completely exhausted after the long voyage
- we started for the last part at Trinidad
pages.notes: Aerogramm, handschriftlich in violetter Tinte. Die Zeile 'on my account at the Westminster Bank' wurde über der Zeile eingefügt.

pages.transcription:
at 4.30 in the morning, arrived at 5 oclock
in Miami, had a view of the town and the
beach and went straight on with the night
clipper without sleepers at 9 and arrived at
6 in the morning (the sister airship crashed
in the same night.) We found, just coming
out of the tropical heat a nice snowstorm
and you may imagine how we are longing
to settle down for a few weeks of work and
rest. I found here offers from reviews and
newspapers and could write here as much
as I liked, but I have to finish my book.
(or books). By the way: I hear that a 'The
Tide of Fortune' has finally appeared in Eng
land - the first edition was completely
destroyed by fire at the bookbinder and
they had it to print again. I hope, they did
send the six authors copies to Bath - I have
here those of the American edition. Pardon me
if I write so little about what interests you
most - your Eva - but I leave this to Lotte.
Yesterday we had a family dinner at my
brother, tomorrow we are with Berta. Yours
Stefan
pages.notes: Fortsetzung des Briefes auf der Rückseite des Aerogramms.

result.confidence_notes: Der Text ist sehr gut lesbar. Die Handschrift ist klar, trotz einiger kleinerer orthographischer Eigenheiten des Autors.
